Areas of practice
Diaz Reus offers U.S. and international legal services. Multicultural, multilingual attorneys provide international legal representation in high-stakes litigation and precedent-setting legal matters in various areas of practice. Reach, experience, and acute know-how are the hallmarks of Diaz Reus international attorneys.

“The customer service was excellent, they were knowledgeable, and they always offered alternative solutions to every issue.”

- Chambers Latin America

International Litigation and Arbitration
Our international litigators have successfully handled complex, multi-jurisdictional cases and parallel proceedings for noted multinational corporations
Learn More
White Collar Crime, Government Sanctions
Diaz Reus internationally renowned white-collar criminal defense attorneys know white-collar crime in depth
Learn More
International Fraud and Asset Recovery
Diaz Reus’ international fraud and asset recovery attorneys frequently represent victims of high-stakes massive international financial fraud.
Learn More
Regulatory and Corporate Investigations, Governance and Compliance
We help our clients comply with U.S. government regulations at all levels, as well as to establish and maintain their global commercial operations.
Learn More
Corporate / M&A
Diaz Reus’ attorneys possess a mastery of mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, strategic investments, reorganizations, as well as issues concerning corporate governance and director and officer fiduciary responsibility.
Learn More
Corporate, Business Transactions and International Trade
We help clients and their businesses increase their profits, protect their assets and reach their specific goals. Our services are designed to help clients.
Learn More
Blockchain and Cryptocurrency
Diaz Reus’ “Cryptocurrency Team” advises and represents private individuals, businesses, and financial institutions on matters relating to cryptocurrency and blockchain
Learn More
DRRT
DRRT clients include sovereign wealth and public pension funds, mutual fund companies and (re-) insurance companies,
Learn More
Estate and Tax Planning
Diaz Reus’ estate planners, international tax attorneys and global consultants craft cross-border estate plans, trusts, tax plans, business-succession strategies, and estate-administration initiatives.
Learn More
Athlete Representation & Entertainment Law
Diaz Reus provides a team to protect all aspects of the athlete’s or entertainer’s career, brand, and related legal concerns.
Learn More
Intellectual Property
Diaz Reus’ intellectual property law practice represents companies based in the US, Asia, Latin America and Western and Eastern Europe, protecting their intellectual property assets globally.
Learn More
Real Estate
Diaz Reus’ international real estate attorneys provide a range of international real estate legal services, both residential and commercial, across the world.
Learn More
Bankruptcy and Asset Recovery
The growth in cross-border commerce and, subsequently, multinational bankruptcies and liquidations requires sophisticated international know-how to help creditors recoup assets dispersed or secreted in various countries.
Learn More
Immigration for Business and Individuals
Diaz Reus’ immigration lawyers expedite employer immigration-compliance, employment-based immigrant visas, EB-5 investor matters, family-based immigrant visas.
Learn More
Family Law
Our Law attorneys and solicitors operate successfully across international borders and legal systems in divorce, prenuptial agreements, child custody and other multicultural family-law matters.
Learn More
